response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY account_id), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS a FROM c), j AS (SELECT c.account_id, cu.town_city, c.cnt FROM c JOIN Accounts ac ON ac.account_id = c.account_id JOIN Customers cu ON cu.customer_id = ac.customer_id WHERE cu.town_city IS NOT NULL AND cu.town_city <> '') SELECT j.account_id, j.town_city, j.cnt AS transaction_count, j.cnt * 1.0 / SUM(j.cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY j.town_city) AS share_of_town_transactions, j.cnt / avg_c.a AS ratio_to_average FROM j CROSS JOIN avg_c ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, j.account_id LIMIT 10
